item.title: ADJUSTMENT IN HUDSON YARDS DISTRICT IMPROVEMENT BONUS CONTRIBUTION AMOUNT
item.description:
City Planning | Special Materials | Notice

ADJUSTMENT IN HUDSON YARDS DISTRICT IMPROVEMENT BONUS CONTRIBUTION AMOUNT

 

As provided in Section 93-31 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, the required contribution amount per square foot of bonused floor area available through the District Improvement Fund Bonus in the Special Hudson Yards District has been increased from $169.68 per square foot to $175.62 per square foot as of August 1, 2026. 

In accordance with Section 93-31, this increase is based on the change in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI), as published by the U.S. Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics.  The CPI change for the period between July 1, 2025 and July 1, 2026 was an increase of 3.5 percent.
